blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III paid tribute to the late former Speaker Pro Tempore Raul A. Daza on Monday for his more than five decades of public service, showing his commitment to the Filipino people. “Today, we gather as one House family to honor and remember a man who devoted more than five decades of his life to serving our country. More than 50 years. More than half a century serving the country,” Dy said in a mix of English and Filipino in his eulogy, which was delivered on his behalf by Senior Deputy Speaker Ferdinand […]...
